`manuscript_results.csv` contains semantic selectors and accepted values copied
from the independently frozen Stage 07 compact manuscript-results artifact,
whose scientific values were compared with the fixed Stage 02 reference.
It deliberately omits source paths, row positions, formatting, and duplicate
manuscript claims. It covers strict-inversion examples, cabinet set/duration/
status distinctions, A/B signs, both ideological universes, one-gap counts,
party rankings, and district magnitudes. Tests never read migration artifacts.
Do not regenerate expectations from the implementation under test.

`domains.csv` copies the 12 year/universe/k count tuples directly from the
independently frozen Stage 02 ideological-universe comparison table.
